title: SteelSeries’ comfy wireless gaming headset is nearly half off
summary: At just 260 grams, the Nova 3P are light enough for hours of gaming without strain, and almost half off at Woot. While many gaming headsets come with extra features, the tradeoff is that they’re often uncomfortable and heavy.
